can_be_cut.description: If true, players can cut both incoming and outgoing leashes by using shears on the entity.

can_be_stolen.description: If true, players can leash this entity even if it is already leashed to another entity.

presets.description: Defines how this entity behaves when leashed to another entity. The first preset which "filter" conditions are met will be applied; if none match, a default configuration is used instead.

hard_distance.description: Distance (in blocks) over which the entity starts being pulled towards the leash holder with a spring-like force. Entities can enter and stay in vehicles if the leash is stretched under this distance, but will dismount once it exceeds it.

max_distance.description: Distance in blocks at which the leash breaks.

description: Allows this entity to be leashed and defines the conditions and events for this entity when is leashed.
